<page>
Harbor Point Mutual Auto Insurance
Bodily Injury Unit
Claim Notes
Claim number:
C-1467
Claimant:
Karen Smith
Adjuster:
Christopher Wong
14 Jan 2025
First notice of loss received for a collision at an intersection where the insured was turning left and was struck in the
side by an oncoming vehicle. The claimant's attorney has written to confirm representation and asks that all contact
be directed through their office.
15 Feb 2025
Reviewed the police report, which places the claimant inside the vehicle at the time of impact and records the scene
as consistent with the reported left turn. Photos taken at the scene show the damage pattern and confirm several of
the details the insured described.
27 Feb 2025
Spoke with the claimant's attorney, who provided a summary of injuries including a fracture to the wrist. The injury
appaers consistent in type and force with a side impact of this kind.
3 Apr 2025
Contacted the claimant, who gave the same account of the collision as in the first notice, describing the left turn and
the moment of impact. The account has not changed across each contact so far.
29 Apr 2025
Requested medical records. Initial treatment followed a usual course for this type of fracture, with care tapering off as
the claimant's condition improved.
12 Jun 2025
Medical history shows a minor strain in the same area several years ago, which healed fully with no lasting problems.
Noted for review, though it does not appear to change the current injury picture.
15 Jun 2025
Canvassed the intersection for independent witnesses. None were located, so the claim relies on the police report,
scene photos, and the parties' accounts.
11 Jul 2025
Rveiewed the vehicle file. No earlier damage to the vehicle is known, and nothing in the records suggests the
damage predates the policy's effective date.
26 Aug 2025
Confirmed the driver is a member of the policyholder's household and is covered under the policy as a household
member. Coverage questions have been resolved on this point.
3 Sep 2025
Reviewing whether all of the claimed damage came from this impact. It is not yet clear how much of the treatment and
vehicle damage is attributable to this collision, and the file remains open pending a further review with the attorney.
</page>

Rate each feature below that THIS page gives evidence about. Leave out a feature the page
says nothing about. The ratings are listed from least to most suspicious.
- injury_crash_fit: Does the claimed injury fit the type and force of the crash? Allowed: Strong, Reasonable, Unclear, Inconsistent.
- treatment_growth: Did the treatment grow beyond what this injury needs? Allowed: Normal, Elevated, Disproportionate, Extreme.
- pre_existing_condition: Did an earlier condition of the same body area add to the complaints? Allowed: None, Minor, Material, Predominant.
- occurrence_support: Do independent sources (witnesses, photos, cameras, the other driver) confirm that the accident happened as described? Allowed: Confirmed, Partially corroborated, Uncorroborated, Contradicted, Suspected staged.
- damage_crash_fit: Does the vehicle damage fit the described impact? Allowed: Strong, Reasonable, Unclear, Inconsistent.
- account_stability: Did the claimant's account of the accident stay the same over time? Allowed: Stable, Clarified, Materially changed.
- occupant_presence: Was the claimant really in the vehicle at the time of the crash? Allowed: Verified, Unclear, Added later, Not present.
- prior_damage_evidence: Is there evidence of vehicle damage from before this crash? Allowed: None, Possible, Documented, Material.
- known_loss_evidence: Is there evidence the damage existed or was known before the coverage started? Allowed: Weak, Moderate, Strong.
- driver_status: Is the driver of the insured vehicle on the policy? Allowed: Listed, Household, Unlisted, Excluded.

For each rated feature give:
- "rating": exactly one of the allowed ratings,
- "confidence": "High", "Medium" or "Low" (how clearly the page shows it),
- "quote": one or two sentences copied EXACTLY from the page that support the rating, with any
  spelling errors as they are,
- "reason": one short sentence.
